We need tickets assigned to Luca Brognara in project MER. Use jira issue search with fields summary,status,assignee,duedate maybe. Also need formattedList. We'll run:

jira issue search --jql "project = MER AND assignee = 'Luca Brognara'" --fields summary,status,assignee,duedate
